# `company.vendor_credit_item_lines`

Immutable one-to-one credited item lines of a vendor credit, with captured item, account, quantity, cost and job facts.

Database: `company`.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with transaction_id + revision_id + document_line_id | — | document_lines.id | Revision-local purchase envelope owning this one-to-one credited item profile. |
